The artifact contains only kernel.py, meta.json and problem.txt (no test.py/get_inputs, meta.json passed=null), so problem.txt is the operative contract. It explicitly requires that "every column must be dequantized with the scale and zero-point of the group it actually belongs to, for any K -- including a K that is not an exact multiple of group_size", with scales/zeros supplied as ceil(K/group_size) rows. Three confirmed, in-scope claims show the kernel does not implement that required behavior, each isolated by controls so the failures cannot be attributed to reference-model/packing ambiguity (the divisible-K controls K=64/gs=32, K=32/gs=32, K=32/gs=8 matched the contract reference to 0.0-9.5e-6, validating the packing and zero+1 reference model):

- c1 (decisive): at K=48, group_size=32 (K%16==0, so no k-tail confound) the wrapper's num_groups = K//group_size plus clamp(max=num_groups-1) maps all 48 columns to group 0; the second of the two supplied scale/zero rows is never read. Output matches the "clamped" model to 7.6e-6 and misses the contract reference by max abs 25.65 on |C|max 26.82 (rel 0.956, allclose False). This is exactly the clause the contract spells out, not a tolerance/rounding artifact.
- c2: at K=16 < group_size=32, num_groups=0 yields g_idx=-1 for every column and the kernel reads scales/zeros below the tensor base — it matched a deliberately placed sentinel row bit-exactly (0.0 error) while missing the contract reference by 515.8 vs |C|max 19.35. A silent out-of-bounds read on a K the contract admits.
- c3: at K=40, group_size=8 (group mapping provably contract-correct) the unmasked k-tail tile reads past A, packed-B and g_idx, producing 1.97e25–7.80e36 magnitude garbage versus |C|max ~21–23, with the K=32 control exact.

None of the exculpatory categories apply: the reference is finite and well defined in every case, there is no tie-breaking or declared low-precision allowance at stake, and the deviations are structural (wrong group row / OOB reads), not reduction-order or quantization effects. Unexplored surfaces noted by the Skeptic (unmasked N tail for N%32!=0, the stride_ak==1 assumption at line 52) are set aside as generalization notes; they are not required by the stated contract and would not change the outcome given c1 alone is decisive.
